title: Phase II Sanctuary Expansion & Development Harambee
subject: 🏛️ Special Appeal: Annual Harvest & Building Development Harambee 2026
preheader: Join hands with St. Andrew's Church as we expand God's house for future generations.
headline: Annual Harvest & Building Development Fund Drive
bodyContent:
Dear Members and Friends of PCEA St. Andrew's Church,

Grace and peace to you in the name of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

We warmly invite all congregation members, ministry groups, and partners to our upcoming Annual Harvest and Building Development Harambee. Through your steadfast generosity and prayers, our parish continues to be a vibrant beacon of faith, worship, and compassionate outreach across Nairobi and beyond.

This year, our collective focus is directed towards the Phase II Sanctuary Renovation, Youth Complex modernization, and community benevolent outreach programs.

Every gift, large or small, advances this divine calling. You can give conveniently via M-Pesa Paybill, bank deposit, or in person during Sunday services.

May the Lord bless you abundantly as you prayerfully consider your commitment.
scriptureVerse: Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.

title: Christian Stewardship & Tithes Dedication Week
subject: 📖 Walking in Faith: Christian Stewardship & Tithe Dedication
preheader: Reflecting on our covenant of faithful giving, time, talent, and treasure.
headline: Christian Stewardship & Tithes Dedication Week
bodyContent:
Dear Church Members and Leaders,

Scripture reminds us that all that we have comes from God, and of His own do we give back to Him (1 Chronicles 29:14).

As we embark on our Annual Stewardship Week, we invite every member to reflect on our individual and family covenant with God. Our transparent financial requisition system and ledger books ensure that every cent given is faithfully directed to kingdom work, church group ministries, and welfare programs.

Join us this Sunday as we dedicate our pledge envelopes and pray over our collective stewardship for the upcoming financial year.
scriptureVerse: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house. Test me in this, says the Lord Almighty, and see if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven.

title: NextGen Youth Mission & Leadership Summit
subject: 🔥 NextGen 2026: Youth Leadership & Mission Summit
preheader: Empowering youth in faith, career, and community transformation.
headline: NextGen Youth Conference & Evangelism Mission 2026
bodyContent:
Calling all youth, young adults, and fellowship leaders!

The PCEA St. Andrew's Youth Ministry invites you to the 2026 NextGen Summit. Under the theme 'Rooted & Unshakable', this conference will feature dynamic worship sessions, vocational leadership panels, and local outreach.

Register today to secure your seat and participation materials.
scriptureVerse: Don't let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith and in purity.

title: Phase I Sanctuary Renovation Progress & Expenditure Digest
subject: 📊 Transparency Report: Sanctuary Milestone & Budget Clearance
preheader: Detailed review of completed works and verified requisition disbursements.
headline: Phase I Sanctuary Renovation Milestone Report
bodyContent:
Dear Congregation,

In accordance with our constitutional transparency mandate, the Development Committee and Finance Treasury present the financial clearance report for Phase I Sanctuary structural reinforcement.

All requisitions underwent strict Level 1 and Level 2 approvals before disbursement. Thank you for your continued financial commitment.
scriptureVerse: The God of heaven will give us success. We his servants will start rebuilding.

title: Woman's Guild Benevolent Care & Community Outreach
subject: 🌸 Woman's Guild Community Health & Food Basket Drive
preheader: Supporting vulnerable families across informal settlements in Nairobi.
headline: Woman's Guild Benevolent Care & Outreach Mission
bodyContent:
Praise be to God.

The Woman's Guild invites all members to contribute dry foodstuffs, clothing, and funds towards our quarterly compassionate basket drive.

Our teams will visit hospitals and families in need on Saturday, August 1st. Requisitions for transport and dry goods logistics have been submitted and verified.
scriptureVerse: In everything I did, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words the Lord Jesus himself said: 'It is more blessed to give than to receive.'
